{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I was honored to be present when the huge, shiny, pouch-like pupa burst open, revealing the male Ruurian in his new butterflylike chroma-wing form. As he emerged, he looked desperate, and his face was flushed. Immediately, the larval Ruurians of the family guided the new chroma-wing to a room where his mate was waiting patiently, and they left them alone as they prepared a feast and comfortable nesting place for the couple.|Senior Anthropologist Mamoon Hoole|<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
The '''chroma-wing''' was the fourth and final life stage of the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After spending years in the [[Larva/Legends|larval]] stage, the Ruurian entered the [[Pupa/Legends|pupa]] stage before emerging as a [[Butterfly/Legends|butterflylike]] chroma-wing. Ruurians in the chroma-wing stage were focused only on mating to produce the next generation, and were required to do nothing more than mating, eating, and sleeping.<ref name="EGTAS" />
